description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, blinking Quintorius Kand, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Quintorius Kand's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it, exiling Manamorphose and Flicker from your graveyard with the ability to cast them this turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Cast Manamorphose from exile by paying {1}{R/G}.
Quintorius Kand triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve Manamorphose, adding {1}{W} and causing you to draw a card.
Cast Flicker from exile by paying {1}{W}.
Quintorius Kand triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Repeat from step 2.
